verdict.rationale: The docs say smolagents uses the OpenTelemetry standard to instrument agent runs, which supports tracing runs in an external observability backend. Memory access and agent.replay() add local inspection of steps. The pack has only a single line on instrumentation, though, and does not show per-LLM-call and per-tool-call spans or a named UI to view them in. missing for 10: explicit evidence that every LLM call and tool invocation is captured as spans, documented integration with a specific observability UI, setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
